description: A variable holding a list of labels can't be the labels attribute
notes: The documentation of Expand says the labels attribute is evaluated with the given variables and functions, which an expression that evaluates to a list of labels would allow. hashicorp/hcl requires a static list and evaluates its elements one by one with the iterator in scope (hcl.ExprList in expandBody.decodeSpec, and expandSpec.newBlock, in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
reference_error: A static list expression is required
